title: The Sky Dimension
description: this mod adds a sky dimension, located 20k blocks above spawn there is the sky dimension, there is a classic skyblock island there.
body:
This mod adds a dimension to the overworld. 20,000 blocks from the ground there exists a dimension which you can build in. The classic skyblock island exists up there.

from u.u.

first mod in my uu terrain mods.
